title: Wave 11 - promoted from rnd: live testnet acceptance runs (xrpl-lab 2.6.0 AMM)
domain_scope: dex-amm, client-libraries (rnd promotion; gotchas appended to existing rows)
verifier_note: Promotion, not a research swarm. Promoted from rnd entry 2026-10-20-live-testnet-runs-surface-defects-in-layers-each-fix-exposed. Rig receipts read by R&D, 2026-10-20 (xrpl-lab docs/receipts/2.6.0-amm-live-fire, PR #19, issue #20); no cloud seat, no second model family. Gotchas are appended to existing rows; their verified flag is unchanged.

updates.gotcha_append: Live-fire (xrpl-lab 2.6.0, Testnet): the AMMCreate fee equals the owner reserve increment (reserve_inc, 200,000 drops on Testnet at the time). A pool funded from a single 100 XRP faucet grant fails tecUNFUNDED_AMM, because after the base reserve, the trust-line reserve and that fee only about 98.6 XRP is spendable; the module succeeded with a 25/25 pool.
updates.verify_note: rig receipts read by R&D, 2026-10-20 (xrpl-lab docs/receipts/2.6.0-amm-live-fire); no cloud seat

sources.title: xrpl-lab 2.6.0 AMM live-fire receipts (four Testnet runs and README)
sources.claim: AMMCreate fee = reserve_inc; a 100 XRP pool from one faucet grant validated tecUNFUNDED_AMM (about 98.6 XRP spendable); 25/25 succeeded.

sources.title: xrpl-lab PR #19 (2.6.0): the fixes between the live runs
sources.claim: The fixes resized the module's pool to 25/25 for AMMCreate and 5/5 for the deposit, and added a reserve preflight before AMMCreate.

updates.gotcha_append: Live-fire (xrpl-lab 2.6.0, Testnet): after the sole LP withdraws everything (tfWithdrawAll) the AMM is deleted and amm_info returns actNotFound.
updates.verify_note: rig receipts read by R&D, 2026-10-20 (xrpl-lab docs/receipts/2.6.0-amm-live-fire); no cloud seat

sources.title: xrpl-lab 2.6.0 AMM live-fire receipts (four Testnet runs and README)
sources.claim: After the sole LP's tfWithdrawAll the pool was deleted and amm_info returned actNotFound.

updates.gotcha_append: Live-fire (xrpl-lab 2.6.0, Testnet): submit_and_wait waits on a held (ter) result until LastLedgerSequence passes (about 20 ledgers, about 80 s). A client timeout shorter than that discards the hash and the preliminary result, so sign first so the hash survives.
updates.verify_note: rig receipts read by R&D, 2026-10-20 (xrpl-lab docs/receipts/2.6.0-amm-live-fire); no cloud seat

sources.title: xrpl-lab 2.6.0 AMM live-fire receipts (four Testnet runs and README)
sources.claim: submit_and_wait waits on a held result until LastLedgerSequence passes (~20 ledgers); a shorter client timeout loses the hash and preliminary result.

sources.title: xrpl-lab PR #19 (2.6.0): the fixes between the live runs
sources.claim: The fixes sign the transaction before submitting it, so its hash survives a timeout, and raise the client timeout to 150 s, above the ~80 s ledger window.

updates.gotcha_append: Live-fire (xrpl-lab 2.6.0, Testnet): a faucet reply is not proof of funding. Wait for the validated balance before the next transaction; an issuer AccountSet sent before the account was on a validated ledger never validated, and later AMM steps were held terNO_RIPPLE / terNO_AMM.
updates.verify_note: rig receipts read by R&D, 2026-10-20 (xrpl-lab docs/receipts/2.6.0-amm-live-fire); no cloud seat

sources.title: xrpl-lab 2.6.0 AMM live-fire receipts (four Testnet runs and README)
sources.claim: A faucet reply carried no usable balance; an AccountSet sent before the account was validated never validated and later steps were held terNO_RIPPLE / terNO_AMM.

sources.title: xrpl-lab PR #19 (2.6.0): the fixes between the live runs
sources.claim: The fixes wait for the validated balance after a faucet grant before sending the next transaction.

sources.title: xrpl-lab issue #20: handlers with the same funding race
sources.claim: xrpl-lab issue #20 lists 11 more handlers with the same funding race (a faucet reply taken as proof of funding).
